page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Running head at top with page number at left. Above the text block a continuation of the previous letter's last lines, then a signature/date line. Below a rule, a division heading (XXXI.), title block, sender line, and body text in one column.

main_text.p: dotes, sua benevolentia sponte profequitur, & benigne complectitur.
Signatum Augustæ Misnensium prid. Non. Feb. anno 1584.
main_text.head: XXXI. EPISTOLA ELECORIS SAXONIÆ ad HENRICUM III. GALLIÆ REGEM.
main_text.p: Ex iis literis quibus Serenitas Regia vestra, nos suscipiendam curam pacis publicæ nuper amantissime hortata est, facile perspeximus quam vehementer de incolumitate Imperii Germanici solicita est, unde tanto referendæ gratiæ studio incensi fuimus, ut pari solicitudine pro dignitate & commodis Serenitatis vestræ Regiæ afficiamur.

page.notes: The initial E of the body paragraph is a large woodcut-style initial, joined to "x iis" as printed. Catchword "Quare" is set at the right below the last line and is treated as a catchword-like word; the running text itself is complete. Printed date line reads "1584" with old-style numerals in the scan.
